name: sap-test
description: Run from the repo root. Bun installs everything; Playwright itself always runs on Node (its CLI's shebang). Deliberately not a workspace: app/ and sap-tests/ keep separate dependency trees, or the fork's @playwright/test alias (Playwright-SAP 1.53) and the app's own Playwright 1.63 collide when hoisted.

scripts.setup: bun install --cwd app && cd sap-tests && bun install --frozen-lockfile && bunx playwright install chromium && cd ../app && bunx playwright install chromium
scripts.check: cd app && bun run check && cd ../sap-tests && bun run typecheck
scripts.lint: cd app && bun run lint && cd ../sap-tests && bun run lint && bun run format:check
scripts.lint:light: cd app && bun run lint:light && cd ../sap-tests && bun run lint
scripts.format: cd app && bun run format && cd ../sap-tests && bun run format
scripts.ci: bun run check && bun run lint && bun run test && bun run test:sap:list && bun run test:e2e
